package reflect_test

import (
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
	"testing/sandboxdriver"

	"github.com/xgo-dev/sandbox"
)

var sandboxReflectCase = flag.String("sandbox-reflect", "", "run one upstream reflect test in Sentry")

var sandboxReflectTests = []testing.InternalTest{
	// TESTS
}

func TestMain(m *testing.M) {
	flag.Parse()
	if *sandboxReflectCase == "" {
		os.Exit(m.Run())
	}
	for _, test := range sandboxReflectTests {
		if test.Name != *sandboxReflectCase {
			continue
		}
		code, completed := 1, false
		executable, err := os.Executable()
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
			os.Exit(1)
		}
		binaryDir := filepath.Dir(executable)
		s := sandbox.Sandbox{
			Library: os.Getenv("SANDBOX_TEST_LIBRARY"),
			Mounts: []sandbox.Mount{
				{Type: "bind", Source: "/", Target: "/", Options: []string{"ro"}},
				{Type: "tmpfs", Target: "/tmp"},
				{Type: "bind", Source: binaryDir, Target: binaryDir, Options: []string{"ro"}},
				{Type: "proc", Target: "/proc"},
			},
		}
		if err := s.Run(func() {
			code = sandboxdriver.Run(test)
			completed = true
		}); err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
			os.Exit(1)
		}
		if !completed {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "guest completion was not written back")
			os.Exit(1)
		}
		os.Exit(code)
	}
	fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "unknown upstream reflect test:", *sandboxReflectCase)
	os.Exit(1)
}
